name: gg-transfer-pricing-and-connected-transactions
description: Prepare Guernsey 2026 domestic connected-transaction and transfer-pricing working papers from the verified income-tax base, anti-avoidance, connected machinery-sale and records rules. Identify the actual adjustment power before changing a price or deduction. Covers the section 108 market-value and written-election calculations, the Revenue Service's approved associated-company reporting treatment, company-by-company evidence, retention periods, omitted-income notifications and information-notice appeals. Distinguishes those rules from treaty associated-enterprise adjustments and specialist international reporting. Includes two recomputing pricing-base examples. This source-cited draft does not establish a complete general transfer-pricing or master-file/local-file regime, nor an exemption from one. Its exact current-scope question remains explicit after independent source review; competent-authority clarification is still required.
